name: Inflection Ingestion Daily Automation
description: All Inflection bronze prefix pulls automated daily without manual intervention. DS~D bronze state audit (2026-05-05) confirms ZERO of 6+ Inflection bronze prefixes are scheduled — every pull script lives in data/orion/manual_api/, none on cron / EventBridge / Lambda schedule. Phase B silver chain Lambda runs daily but consumes whatever bronze partitions happen to exist, producing silent staleness. Same systemic failure class produced AUDIT-002 (canonical_prices 2 weeks stale), AUDIT-008 (silver/assets_v2 5 days stale), and the AUDIT-008 INF_B_00 blocker (silver/api_dims/positions_mv 5 days stale) — three same-class incidents in two weeks. Andrew P1 directive 2026-05-05T~17:52Z: 'daily pulls on ALL INGESTION PIPELINES is priority #1.'

source_brief: COO escalation 20260505T~17:52Z (forwarding Andrew P1 directive); DS~D bronze state audit RAVC during AUDIT-008 cycle.
phase: Phase 0 — Andrew strategic redirect 2026-05-05T~19:32Z: 'we need to just get all the data up to date and set up the pipelines.' Surgical $199M-tonight push CANCELLED; comprehensive catch-up + Phase 1 buildout supersedes. Slip-to-tomorrow accepted across all lanes. AE 0.7 HALTed Dispatch 2 chain-full (PATH A 5-day positions backfill DID complete clean — 5 silver positions_mv partitions @ 24,205 rows); pivots to comprehensive Inflection bronze→silver path-correctness audit + bronze refresh across all stale prefixes (assets/performance/orion-api-v2). AE 0.6.1 continues Phase 0 RAVC3 (Lambda-fit disposition + JWT map + inf-bronze-runner dependency graph). 4th empirical finding (DS~D 19:30Z): convert_orion_api_to_silver.py --dim positions_mv writes FLAT silver/positions_mv/{date}.parquet instead of HIVE silver/api_dims/positions_mv/snapshot_date={date}/data.parquet — likely affects multiple dims; comprehensive audit surfaces. PRD v0.1.1 patch shipped (strategic-pivot scope + OQ1 RESOLVED + Tier 1 CONFIRMED PRESENT). v0.2 ratchet absorbs both AE RAVCs. Phase 1 sub-grouping ENDORSED: Phase 1a (ops cleanup — path-correctness, deployment-pattern, EC2_MANIFEST drift) + Phase 1b (Lambda migration — per-script + EventBridge + scoped IAM). AUDIT-008 close shifts from 'TO-1 ships' to 'atomic close on whole class when Phase 1a + 1b ship'.
blocking: Phase 0 audit RAVC inbound from AE 0.6.1. Phase 1 per-prefix automation TOs follow audit (3-5 expected). PATH B revisit gates on Phase 0 surfacing positions_mv automation as fundamentally fragile (vendor API limits / rate limits / complex auth) — default ruling stays 'fix upstream'.
lane_note: AE 0.6.1 LEAD — owns Inflection bronze pull script set + per-prefix scheduling decisions. AE 0.7 SECONDARY — EventBridge rule authoring + IAM role updates + cross-resource Terraform if needed. CTO directive: prefer EventBridge cron rules over CronCreate scaffolding (one ingestion → one trigger, observable via CW Metrics + CW Alarms; CronCreate is the operator scaffolding pattern, not the production pattern). Each prefix gets its own observability surface.

waves.label: Audit — enumerate every Inflection bronze prefix + current schedule state + automation gaps + per-prefix runtime characteristics + Lambda-fit disposition (Y/N + reason for any N) + IAM/resource gaps + inf-bronze-runner dependency graph. RAVC = audit deliverable + Phase 1 TO scope sketch + EC2 decom recommendation.

Per-prefix automation — 3-5 Lambda-native TOs (per-script Lambda + EventBridge cron + scoped IAM + CW Metric/Alarm). TO-1 = assets_v2 (absorbs AUDIT-008.PERM). EC2 outliers only with explicit Phase 0 justification.
inf-bronze-runner EC2 deprecation if 100% pulls Lambda-native (zero-responsibilities check + IAM/SG/EBS teardown + Terraform module removal).
Cross-prefix freshness dashboard + alarming consolidation (optional; depends on P1 emergent observability needs).
